title: Convert Measurement Units
objective: I can convert measurement units using ratios and conversion factors.
model: ratio table / double number line with a conversion factor, deciding by unit size whether to multiply or divide

widgets.root: These are the lesson's own warm-up items (ratio reasoning feeding conversions); keys correct (2:3, 36, ×3, 5:8 and 15:25).

widgets.component: 7 ft to in, 3 yd to ft, 4 lb to oz, 24 in to ft, 30 in as feet and inches
widgets.root: Keys correct (84, 9, 64, 2, 2 ft 6 in); factors are the grade-level facts.

widgets.component: given / conversion factor / answer table; part / measurement / target unit / converted table
widgets.root: Six conversions, both directions (54 in -> 4.5 ft, 96 oz -> 6 lb); factor shown in the row.
Direction-of-operation misconceptions, both ways round, with the 'smaller unit gives a bigger number' check.

widgets.component: six conversion pairs (3 yd to 9 ft, 4 ft to 48 in, 5 lb to 80 oz …)
widgets.root: Each pair requires a conversion, not recall of one fact; all six verified.

widgets.component: days to hours on a double number line, weeks and days in a ratio table, mixed yards and feet
widgets.root: 300 seeds rendered for L1 and L2: the double number line starts at 0 on both lines, bottom row is exactly factor × top row; ratio table rows are proportional. Static, but they carry the lesson's representation.
Manipulable model; the chain does not use the unit-cancelling fraction form named in the lesson's keyIdea, but it matches the worked example (multiply by 12 because inches are smaller).

widgets.component: inches in a foot, the 7-foot cabinet in inches, 5 yd to in
'Will the cabinet fit through the 80-inch doorway?'
widgets.root: The stem says 'the cabinet' but only item 5.2 gives its 7-foot height, so it is answerable only by carrying a number from the previous item; the distractor 'Yes, because 84 < 80' is a false statement written as a choice.
widgets.replacement: State the scenario inside the item: 'A cabinet is 7 feet tall. A doorway is 80 inches high. Will the cabinet stand up through the doorway?' and make the wrong choices the real errors (compare 7 with 80 without converting; convert with ÷ 12 and get 0.58).

widgets.component: ratio-table conversions up to 'how many 10-minute portions in 7 hours'
6 ft ÷ vs × yard, ribbon and fabric, 40 m runway in 250 cm sections, cooler 2 gal, track laps, 6 bars of 45 lb in oz
widgets.root: Keys recomputed (16 sections, 0.5 gal left, 9 laps and 3.6 km, 4,320 oz); two-step chains use the stated factors.

widgets.root: Pairs verified; chain ends in a stated unit.
